name: Cash Offer / 14-Day Close
summary: No lender, no appraisal. The short timeline cash buys earn.

milestones.name: Offer Accepted
milestones.buyerNote: The seller has signed. Paying cash means no lender and no appraisal, which is why this moves so quickly.
milestones.waitingOn: Nothing — sit tight, we will tell you when we need you

milestones.name: Earnest Money Deposit
milestones.buyerNote: Your good-faith deposit goes to the escrow company. It is credited back to you at closing.
milestones.waitingOn: You — wire the deposit to escrow

milestones.name: Proof of Funds Verified
milestones.buyerNote: The seller's side confirms your funds are real and available. A recent bank statement is usually all it takes.

milestones.name: Home Inspection
milestones.buyerNote: An inspector walks the home and sends a written report. Short timelines make this window tight, so we book it early.

milestones.name: Inspection Response
milestones.buyerNote: We decide together what to ask the seller for, and send it over.
milestones.waitingOn: The seller's answer to our request

milestones.name: Title Search
milestones.buyerNote: The title company checks that the seller can legally sell and that no old debts follow the property.

milestones.name: Final Walkthrough
milestones.buyerNote: We walk the home one last time to confirm nothing has changed since your inspection.

milestones.name: Closing Day
milestones.buyerNote: You sign, the funds move, and the keys are yours. Bring photo ID.
